description: Exactly sum bounded dyadic values with a binary64 Grow-Expansion and return fixed-point integer units.

source.title: Adaptive Precision Floating-Point Arithmetic and Fast Robust Geometric Predicates
source.algorithm_attribution: Two-Sum error-free transforms and Grow-Expansion from Shewchuk's exact floating-point expansion arithmetic.
source.implementation_status: Clean-room bounded ports from the published algorithm description; no published source code copied.

input.term_value: mantissa * 2^exponent; all terms are exactly representable in IEEE-754 binary64

contract.rounding_environment: IEEE-754 binary64, round-to-nearest, ties-to-even; no fast-math reassociation
contract.primary_algorithm: Maintain a nonoverlapping expansion in increasing-magnitude order. Add each nonzero input value with Grow-Expansion, using general Two-Sum to emit each exact residual and the rounded accumulator. Sum the expansion components as integer units after scaling each by 2^30.
contract.independent_method: The verifier maps each input directly to integer units: mantissa * 2^(exponent+30), then sums those integers without floating-point operations.
contract.observable_result: Because the input exponents are at least -30, the exact sum is an integer multiple of 2^-30. The output adds 2^58+1 to the scaled integer so every exact sum is visible while valid results cannot collide with the -1 invalid sentinel.
contract.bound_reason: At most 16 terms each have absolute value at most 2^24; after scaling by 2^30, the sum of absolute units is at most 2^58. Adding the offset gives valid outputs in [1,2^59+1], safely inside signed 64-bit range.

complexity.time: O(n^2) Two-Sum operations in the worst case, with n<=16.
